Sarah Morris, APRN, FNP-C is a board-certified Family Nurse Practitioner with specialized expertise in oculoplastic care. Originally from Flemingsburg, Kentucky, Sarah earned her Bachelor of Science in Exercise Science from the University of Kentucky before pursuing her Bachelor of Science in Nursing at Bellarmine University in Louisville, Kentucky.

Following completion of her nursing degree, Sarah practiced in the Cardiovascular Intensive Care Unit at University of Kentucky Hospital, where she developed a strong clinical foundation caring for complex medical and surgical patients. She later earned her Family Nurse Practitioner degree from the University of South Florida in Tampa, graduating with honors and earning induction into the Sigma Theta Tau International Honor Society of Nursing. She is an active member of the American Association of Nurse Practitioners.

At AestheticEye, Sarah works closely with Dr. Ginger Henson and Dr. Jon Pargament to provide comprehensive perioperative and non-surgical care. She manages post-operative patients, performs in-office procedures such as biopsies of suspicious lesions and chalazion treatments when clinically indicated, and offers aesthetic services including neurotoxin treatments with Dysport® and Botox® as well as UltraClear® laser treatments.

Outside of the office, Sarah enjoys staying active, spending time outdoors, and attending sporting events—especially cheering on the Kentucky Wildcats. She also values time traveling and making memories with her husband, Nat, and their two daughters.
